---
output:
  html_document:
    theme: null
    highlight: null
    mathjax: null
    toc: false
    self_contained: true
params:
  lCharts: NA
  dfResults: NA
  dfMetrics: NA
  dfGroups: NA
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(gsm.core)
library(gsm.kri)

setup <- Report_Setup(
  dfResults = params$dfResults,
  dfMetrics = params$dfMetrics,
  dfGroups = params$dfGroups
)
dfResults_current <- FilterByLatestSnapshotDate(params$dfResults)
```

---
pagetitle: "`r setup$StudyLabel` · `r setup$GroupLevel` KRI Report"
---

```{r v2-report}
# Overview widgets: group overview plus flags over time when deltas are available.
lOverview <- list(
  groupOverview = Widget_GroupOverview(
    dfResults = dfResults_current,
    dfMetrics = params$dfMetrics,
    dfGroups = params$dfGroups,
    strGroupLevel = setup$GroupLevel,
    strGroupSubset = switch(setup$GroupLevel, Site = "red", "all"),
    strGroupLabelKey = switch(setup$GroupLevel, Site = "InvestigatorLastName", NULL)
  )
)

if (any(grepl("_Change", names(params$dfResults)))) {
  strSnapshotDates <- unique(params$dfResults$SnapshotDate) %>%
    sort(decreasing = TRUE) %>%
    head(12L)
  dfResultsFlagged <- params$dfResults %>%
    FilterByFlags(bCurrentlyFlagged = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$SnapshotDate %in% strSnapshotDates)

  lOverview$flagOverTime <- Widget_FlagOverTime(
    dfResults = dfResultsFlagged,
    dfMetrics = params$dfMetrics,
    strGroupLevel = setup$GroupLevel,
    strFootnote = glue::glue(
      "Table displays the {length(strSnapshotDates)} most recent snapshots and only includes risk signals flagged in the most recent snapshot."
    ),
    bExcludeEver = TRUE
  )
}

overviewTabs <- htmltools::tags$div(
  class = "v2-card v2-reveal",
  `data-tabs-scope` = "overview",
  htmltools::tags$div(
    class = "v2-toolbar",
    htmltools::tags$div(
      class = "v2-tabs",
      role = "tablist",
      lapply(seq_along(lOverview), function(i) {
        htmltools::tags$button(
          type = "button", role = "tab", class = "v2-tab",
          `data-pane` = names(lOverview)[i],
          `aria-selected` = tolower(i == 1),
          htmltools::HTML(rlang::`%||%`(attr(lOverview[[i]], "output_label", exact = TRUE), names(lOverview)[i]))
        )
      })
    )
  ),
  htmltools::tags$div(
    class = "v2-overview-body",
    lapply(seq_along(lOverview), function(i) {
      htmltools::tags$div(
        class = paste("v2-pane", if (i == 1) "active"),
        `data-pane` = names(lOverview)[i],
        htmltools::tags$div(class = paste("gsm-widget", names(lOverview)[i]), lOverview[[i]])
      )
    })
  )
)

# KRI cards ordered by severity, matching the sidebar.
lSummary <- gsm.kri:::ReportV2_Summary(dfResults_current)
dfCounts <- gsm.kri:::v2_metric_counts(dfResults_current, params$dfMetrics)
metricCards <- lapply(dfCounts$MetricID, function(strMetricID) {
  lCharts <- params$lCharts[[strMetricID]]
  if (is.null(lCharts)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  lMetric <- params$dfMetrics %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$MetricID == strMetricID) %>%
    as.list()
  gsm.kri:::ReportV2_MetricCard(lCharts, lMetric, dfResults_current)
})
intCollapsed <- sum(dfCounts$red + dfCounts$amber == 0)

htmltools::tags$div(
  class = "v2-root",
  gsm.kri:::ReportV2_Dependencies(),
  gsm.kri:::ReportV2_Topbar(setup, dfResults_current, params$dfGroups),
  htmltools::tags$div(
    class = "v2-shell",
    gsm.kri:::ReportV2_Nav(params$dfResults, params$dfMetrics),
    htmltools::tags$main(
      class = "v2-main",
      gsm.kri:::ReportV2_Masthead(setup),
      gsm.kri:::ReportV2_KPICards(lSummary, setup$GroupLevel),
      gsm.kri:::ReportV2_Takeaways(lSummary, dfResults_current, params$dfMetrics, params$dfGroups),
      htmltools::tags$section(
        id = "v2-overview",
        htmltools::tags$div(
          class = "v2-section-head",
          htmltools::tags$div(
            htmltools::tags$h2(paste(setup$GroupLevel, "overview")),
            htmltools::tags$p(class = "v2-section-sub", "Current flag status for every KRI.")
          )
        ),
        overviewTabs
      ),
      gsm.kri:::ReportV2_FlagChanges(params$dfResults, params$dfMetrics, params$dfGroups),
      htmltools::tags$section(
        id = "v2-kris",
        htmltools::tags$div(
          class = "v2-section-head",
          htmltools::tags$div(
            htmltools::tags$h2("Key risk indicators"),
            htmltools::tags$p(class = "v2-section-sub", "Sorted by severity. KRIs without red or amber flags start collapsed.")
          ),
          htmltools::tags$div(
            class = "v2-seg",
            htmltools::tags$button(type = "button", `data-v2-expand` = "expand", "Expand all"),
            htmltools::tags$button(type = "button", `data-v2-expand` = "collapse", "Collapse all")
          )
        ),
        metricCards,
        if (intCollapsed > 0) {
          htmltools::tags$p(class = "v2-collapse-note", sprintf("%d KRI%s without flags %s collapsed.", intCollapsed, if (intCollapsed == 1) "" else "s", if (intCollapsed == 1) "is" else "are"))
        }
      ),
      gsm.kri:::ReportV2_MetricReference(params$dfMetrics),
      htmltools::tags$footer(
        class = "v2-footer",
        htmltools::tags$span(paste("Generated by gsm.kri", utils::packageVersion("gsm.kri"))),
        htmltools::tags$span(paste(setup$StudyLabel, "\u00B7 snapshot", setup$SnapshotDate))
      )
    )
  )
)
```
